**Daily Market Summary · 24 November 2026**

**Snapshot**
• Bitcoin near $61,389: about -5.5% over 7 days, -23% over 30 days.
• Headline BEARISH, confidence LOW; the long-term trend slipped from "still up" to "flat" today.
• Fear & Greed is 11 out of 100 (extreme fear).

**What happened (last 24h)**
• Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, the Nasdaq 100 jumped about 7% and Bitcoin briefly passed $64,000, then fell back below $61,000 the same evening (PANews).
• About $638 million of crypto bets were forced to close in 24 hours, about $512 million of them bets on a fall, as price jumped (PANews, citing CoinGlass).
• About $487 million left US Bitcoin funds in the latest day, while Abraxas Capital moved about $1.18 billion of Bitcoin off exchanges in three days (PANews).

**Short-term outlook (next 1-7 days)**
The next days lean clearly down.
• Turns up: a close above $63,250 (top of a typical week's swing), then $68,210 (200-week average).
• Sideways: between $58,952 and $63,250; a typical week lately swings about $3,971.
• Turns down: a close below $58,952 (the 30-day low).
• Rally watch: drop window open since 11 November; a rally signal needs about $70,143, a fresh drop signal a close below about $59,752.
• This week: US PCE inflation on 25 November, US Thanksgiving closures; next Fed meeting 8 December.

**News that matters**
• US files to forfeit over $1 billion stolen from Binance (PANews) — medium term, small positive.
• Upbit and Bithumb flag Sky's USDS stablecoin as a warning asset (PANews) — short term, small negative.
• US CFTC lets platforms count Bitcoin, Ether and stablecoins toward reserves (PANews) — long term, small positive.

**Altcoins & themes**
• Tokenized stocks are the hot theme: tokenized Nvidia stock rose about 25% in a day with the real shares (PANews).
• New on Reku: Fusionist (ACE) was exploited; the project says exchanges paused ACE deposits and withdrawals.

**Bigger picture**
The next month leans down and the 3-6 month picture is now flat; it firms up only with closes back above $68,210 (200-week average) and then $72,142 (200-day average).

https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Digital marketing / Paid** — Keep spend defensive: the headline is BEARISH and the Rally watch drop window from 11 November is still open. Trim trader-targeted campaigns, run everything on a 30-day return stop-loss and hold the freed budget as a reserve. Shift new-user creatives to stablecoins and safety, and keep rebound creatives ready to launch only if Bitcoin closes above $63,250 and then $68,210.

**Social media & content** — Keep the usual rhythm with a calm, factual tone; upbeat price posts would ring false with fear at 11. Today's best topics: why Bitcoin jumped above $64,000 with tech stocks on the Nvidia news and then fell back (PANews), a 'not all stablecoins are the same' explainer after Upbit and Bithumb flagged USDS, and a short 'what is PCE' post ahead of the 25 November release.

**CRM** — No promotional pressure while the drop window is open. Send active holders a calm update with reference points (the 30-day low near $58,952, the 200-week average near $68,210), add a short account-safety and stablecoin tip using the USDS and Binance-hack news, and have the onboarding journey ready but not switched on: new sign-ups and first deposits tend to arrive 2-4 weeks after a rally starts.

**SEO** — Three "High" topics from what Pintu, Indodax and Pluang published today:
• Bitcoin's Nvidia bounce and fall back (Pintu, Pluang): refresh a "why is Bitcoin up/down today" page that explains how tech stocks and crypto moved together.
• US PCE inflation on 25 November (Pintu, Pluang): publish a short "what is PCE and why crypto watches it" explainer before the release.
• Binance hack money and recovery (Pluang): refresh a safety guide on how stolen funds are traced and frozen.
Each is likely to draw searches because it is in this week's news; check against Reku's pages. Details: https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Altcoins** — Among the ten largest coins, PANews reports Grayscale's first fund that doubles Zcash's daily move began trading (ZEC -1.3% in 24h), BitMine added 7,819 ETH last week (ETH 0.0%), and Ondo accused Backpack of wash trading in tokenized Anthropic stock on Solana (SOL +2.5%). The hot theme is tokenized stocks: tokenized Nvidia stock rose about 25% in a day as Nvidia reinstated its CEO (PANews). Caution: Upbit and Bithumb flagged Sky's SKY (-2.3%) and its USDS stablecoin as warning assets. New on Reku: COTI is now live on Thailand's Bitkub, according to the project, while Fusionist (ACE, -18.3% over 7 days) was exploited and, according to the project, exchanges have paused ACE deposits and withdrawals.
